Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J. 
1. Mr. Sandeep Tiwari and Mr. Yogesh Kumar 
Sharma, learned counsel for the applicant.
2. Mr. Himanshu Sain, learned A.G.A. for the State.
3. Mr. Suryakant Maithani and Mr. Kirti Sharan 
Agarwal, learned counsel for the respondent.
4. Let the State may get the instructions from the 
concerned S.D.M. whether property in question 
relating to the proceeding initiated under section 164 
of BNSS, 2023, is the same, which is the suit property 
of Civil Suit No. 93 of 2007.
5. Learned counsel for the complainant shall 
handover the copy of the plaint of Civil Suit No. 93 of 
2007 to the S.D.M. concerned so that the S.D.M. after 
spot inspection may submit his report positively by 
the next date.
6. List on 30.09.2026.
 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
